name: filmautomator
description: Autonomous AI filmmaking on Blender and FFmpeg: plan shots, build scenes, review renders, and produce a finished movie.
long_description:
FilmAutomator turns a plain-language objective into a finished film using software already on this machine.

Give it a creative brief and it plans shots, builds each one in Blender, renders a preview, inspects that preview with a Vision Agent, corrects what looks wrong, renders at final quality, and assembles the result with FFmpeg.

**No paid services.** It runs entirely locally on Blender, FFmpeg, Python and SQLite. A model server (LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp) is optional: without one it falls back to a deterministic plan and judges frames from pixel measurement alone, labelling every synthetic decision as such.

**What it does not do.** This is a production tool, not a chat toy. It renders real frames, which takes real time — `start_production` returns immediately and the work continues in the background. Because a production owns a Blender session on one machine, only one runs at a time.

**Requirements on this machine.** Blender 4.x/5.x and FFmpeg must already be installed (`brew install --cask blender ffmpeg`). Use the `doctor` tool or `filmautomator doctor` to check.

The server speaks MCP over stdio and binds nothing to the network.
